messages.subject: akde warining message
parts:
Hola.

I am running movement anallysis of Andena Condor. When running akde(), I got this warning message. Below is my code and the message. Ay idea on this message?

vgfit.Ami <- variogram.fit(vg.Ami)
fitted.mod.Ami<-ctmm.select(Ami, CTMM=GUESS, verbose = TRUE)
summary(fitted.mod.Ami)
ouf<-fitted.mod.Ami[[1]]
akde.Ami <- akde(Ami,CTMM=ouf)

Warning message:
In t - grid.init(t, dt = dt, W = W) :
  Recycling array of length 1 in vector-array arithmetic is deprecated.
  Use c() or as.vector() instead.

Thanks for your help, all the best

Adrian
